name: Echoes of Warmth
source:
Time, memory, and emotion clash when you meet this mysterious captain during the Starfall Festival. This LAST LEGACY spinoff chapter centers around Adra, a character created by NipuniDraws.

[From in-app]
translation: 当你在星坠节遇见这位神秘船长时，时间、记忆与情感交织碰撞。这是《LAST LEGACY》的衍生篇章，主角是NipuniDraws创作的角色Adra。[引自in-app]
